title: Move-Out Accounting Note: Anticipated Move-Out Charges While the Deposit Itemization Is Under Way
content:
# Anticipated Move-Out Charges — Utility Services Program Final Accounting

**Note.** When the move-out utility payment of a Utility Services Program account is worked out, the anticipated move-out charges taken from the cash deposit held on the lease's Security Deposit Account depend on how far the move-out itemization has come:

1. **Review under way, charges itemized.** When the Security Deposit Account is in move-out review and at least one move-out charge has been itemized on it, the anticipated move-out charges are the itemized move-out charges plus the reserve share of the cash deposit held less those charges.
2. **Review under way, nothing itemized.** When the account is in move-out review and no move-out charge has been itemized, they are the reserve share of the cash deposit held.
3. **Every other situation.** They are the whole cash deposit held.

Each is rounded half up to the cent. The reserve share is the share held back for move-out charges not yet itemized.

**Records read.** The Security Deposit Account's status, its cash deposit held and the move-out charges itemized on it.

## Cases (hypothetical cash deposit held $1,500.00, reserve share 0.60)

| Deposit account | Move-out charges itemized | Anticipated move-out charges |
|---|---|---|
| in move-out review | $300.00 | $300.00 plus 0.60 of $1,200.00, which is $1,020.00 |
| in move-out review | none | 0.60 of $1,500.00, which is $900.00 |
| any other status | any | $1,500.00 |
